ParkMate - An automation parking system :
Developed ParkMate, a smart automated parking system that allows users to check parking availability and reserve slots in
advance based on their preferred date and time. The platform reduces parking congestion and waiting time by enabling real-
time slot booking and efficient parking space management. Built using React for the frontend, Express.js for backend APIs,
and MongoDB, providing a smooth and user-friendly parking experience.
Secure Pay - QR fraud detection system :
Developed SecurePay, a smart app that verifies QR codes before redirecting users to payment apps, preventing fake payment
scams. Each merchant gets a unique, tamper-proof QR stored securely on the blockchain. Built using Flutter, Flask, MongoDB,
and Polygon, combining security with a simple user experience. Empowers users to make digital payments confidently while
ensuring trust and authenticity in every transaction.
